item.title: Machine Investment Group Buys Newly Built Mixed-Use Multifamily Property In Georgetown, Texas
item.description: Machine Investment Group has acquired Rise 120, a newly built property with 227 multifamily units and 15,000 square feet of ground-floor retail in Georgetown, Texas, in an off-market transaction. The asset, delivered in the first quarter of 2024, sits in a fast-growing submarket of the Austin metropolitan area and is positioned near key employment hubs in Georgetown, Round Rock, and North Austin. item.title: Verdane Invests in Clue to Accelerate the Future of Women’s Health
item.description: Clue, a women-led period and cycle tracking health and wellness app with more than 100 million downloads worldwide, has secured what it described as a significant strategic investment from Verdane, a European growth equity firm focused on technology-enabled businesses. The round included backing from Sigma Capital, CMCC Titan Fund, 6th Man Ventures, and Ayon Capital, according to the company.
